descriptionChirho: To make something known to an authority by formal report or disclosure, used in legal/official contexts (Acts 23-25: presenting charges before a governor or commander).

To make visible or manifest, whether actively revealing oneself or being made apparent; includes both active self-revelation (John 14:21-22, Heb 11:14) and passive appearing (Matt 27:53 risen saints appeared; Heb 9:24 appear before God).
